question: I am switching from another insurer. Will my 3 years of waiting period carry over if I increase my sum insured?
answer: Waiting periods you have already served carry over when porting your policy, but credit is granted only up to the sum insured of your previous policy, including any accrued no-claim bonus [1][2][6].
